claim: Patchline ships an independent artifact-evaluation dry run with an external reviewer's reproduction log. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the reproduction log claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make independent-artifact-evaluation-gate`.
